questions.title: Temperature log summary
questions.prompt: `temps.txt` holds the number of readings `n` on the first line, then `n` temperatures (doubles), one per line. Write a program that writes `summary.txt` with three lines: `Min: <min>`, `Max: <max>`, `Mean: <mean>` (1 decimal place each), then prints `Wrote summary.txt`. If `temps.txt` can't be opened, print `Cannot open temps.txt`.
